content_of_post_to_comment: I have what I think is a reasonable request of writers. In the past twenty minutes I’ve had to look up three abbreviations I was unfamiliar with just to understand what I was reading. The radio news standard I learned was to say the say the words in first reference—Independent School District—and then you can use the abbreviation, ISD afterward. For the sake of clarity, please use that guideline. Texting has everybody using shortcuts and to me unexplained abbreviations show a lack of respect for your reader.
